profile.dividendPolicy: AAPICO has a policy to pay dividends to its shareholders at the rate of not less than 30% of net profit after taxes annually. The Company must also fully allocate its retained earnings up to 10% of registered capital for legal reserves in compliance with the Public Limited Company Act. Dividend payment must be approved by the shareholders? meeting. An exception is for interim dividend payment, for which the Board of Directors can approve such payment and report to the next shareholders' meeting.
